subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this exact head's Matrix dependency ownership move and runOutsideGatewayRootWorkAdmission lifecycle seam be approved as the permanent boundaries for stack stage 2?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish behavior, but they cannot authorize the protected dependency graph or decide whether the production gateway admission seam belongs in this migration.

options.title: Approve the stacked migration
options.body: Confirm the gateway lifecycle seam and authorize the exact dependency graph so this stage can land with the temporary qa-matrix shim.

options.title: Split the gateway seam
options.body: Move the production admission-context change into a separately owned gateway PR, then rebase this QA migration on that decision.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this and the dependent workflow PR if maintainers do not want QA Lab to own the complete Matrix runtime and dependency set.

recommendation.title: Approve the stacked migration
recommendation.body: Confirm the gateway lifecycle seam and authorize the exact dependency graph so this stage can land with the temporary qa-matrix shim.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved code-direction choice concerns channel restart lifecycle in the gateway reload module introduced through this owner's prior merged work; secops authorization remains separately required for the lockfile.
